system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: An extension may **also** contribute a **system-prompt contribution** — not a class but a single module whose default export adds terse, durable guidance to the system prompt
system_prompt_style.note: System prompt assembled from extension contributions; presets file cmd/juggler/core/system_prompt_presets.go exists but was not opened.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: A tool the LLM can call (read a file, search, run a command)
env_context_strategy.note: Built-in examples glob, read_file, write_file; no up-front injection seen.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: The oldest history is summarized into a compaction-summary item; the most recent items stay verbatim.
context_compaction.note: Auto recovery on overflow plus /compact. Oversized tool results summarized in place (LLM summary, not truncation); cmd/juggler/ops/output_cap.go suggests output capping but was not opened.

observation_format.evidence_quote: How a file type is shown to you and extracted for the model
observation_format.note: Image viewer and tool_result_image tests suggest image results may exist; not verified.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Select System Prompt to see exactly what the model is told and which tools it can call
tool_call_format.note: Provider tests tool_choice_test.go/tool_use_block_test.go exist in file tree; parser not opened.

tool_count.note: Core extension tool list (web/extensions/juggler-core/) not in evidence.

edit_primitive.note: Edit tool definitions (replace-text, write_file) named but their arguments not in evidence; likely search_replace + whole_file_rewrite.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: an MCP server's tools become context items indistinguishable from the built-in ones
tool_schema_source.note: Built-in tools declared in JS extensions with static MANIFEST (hand-written).

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: point Juggler at an [MCP server](docs/mcp.md) and its tools arrive as inspectable, approvable items like any other.
protocol_standardization.note: other = ACP provider package cmd/juggler/providers/acp/ in file tree.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Controls how the agentic loop runs — turns, tools, stopping
loop_primitives.note: Server is a state machine modifying a Yjs document; plan/research strategies shipped as plugins (plan_execute possibly reachable, unverified).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Strategies** — high-level LLM loops such as `plan`, `research`, or your own fever-dream inventions are plugins too.
planning_granularity.note: Plan strategy's storage format not in evidence.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: runs the expanded prompt in an isolated sub-thread and lands the result back in the conversation
multi_agent_topology.note: Sub-threads reachable via commands; default single agent.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: runs the expanded prompt in an isolated sub-thread and lands the result back in the conversation
delegation_mechanism.note: Opt-in subagent_spawn via subthread run mode.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: When the agent pauses for user intervention — to run a command, apply an edit, take the next step — that paused state is part of the document.
human_in_loop.note: Strategies default, read-only, yolo select approval policy.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: It's a Yjs document, not a transcript.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: MCP servers and skills plug into the same model
long_term_memory.note: Skill loading mechanism not in evidence.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: you can quit or relaunch and it resumes every conversation exactly where you left it.

retry_policy.note: Turn retry on context overflow is step-level, not task retry.

rollback.note: Tree branching/backtrack is conversational; file undo not evidenced.

termination_condition.note: Strategies control stopping but sources not in evidence.

cost_controls.note: cheap_model.go suggests routing for auxiliary tasks; unverified.

timeouts.note: shell_watchdog_test.go suggests per-tool timeout; not opened.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: It does all the work: HTTP/WebSocket server, session store, tool execution.

network_policy.evidence_quote: plugins can add worktrees, remote SSH to build machines, sandboxing, and other exotic environments.
network_policy.note: Sandboxing is roadmap only; web fetch/search ops exist.

permission_model.evidence_quote: an MCP server's tools arrive as inspectable, approvable items like any other.

tracing.evidence_quote: Summary and error items carry the operation's accounting (calls, token usage, duration) in their item data
